Config reference

Widget reads its settings from widget.toml in the project root. Every key is optional; a missing key takes the default shown below. Values are validated when the process starts, and an unknown key is reported with its line number.

Keys

port
The port to listen on. Default 8080.
log_level
One of debug, info, warn, error.

Special characters need escaping in some places: use a literal * or _ when you mean it, a # at the start of a line, 1. numbered text, and [brackets] marks. Paths such as C:\temp\files and snake_case_names should survive too.

- not a list
+ not a list either
1. not numbered
# not a heading
> not a quote

See the API page or email help or jump to top or a link with parens.
